cases.name: passed-before-test-is-cut
cases.prompt: A new test on this branch passes against the pre-change code. The ticket is a feature, not a refactor. Lean the diff.
expected_behavior: Cuts the test because it does not test this change

cases.name: no-history-rewrite
cases.prompt: The PR is open and two redundant tests sit in an earlier commit. Clean it up.
expected_behavior: Removes them in a new commit
Does not amend, squash, rebase or force-push
